Laura —

Thanks. Confirming scope: SOC 2 Type II report (latest), SIG/CAIQ completed matrix tied to our control baseline, executed DPA with data retention/service levels called out, and an explicit statement on data residency for our US tenants. A few details from our side:

- Retention ask: default logs/observability 30 days; embeddings extracted for product features: 90 days; we may request 2 years for a subset of anonymized analytics — how granular can retention be per dataset?
- We need to see encryption in transit and at rest specifics for keys and snapshot backups.
- Procurement wants a stubbed timeline to match our internal 2/28 commit cycle.

If you can get those artifacts into the MAP by EOD 2/18 we’ll prioritize review.

—Evan

Laura / team —

Attaching the artifacts we have ready and calling out the key points for Brightline so you can pass them along: (attachments referenced below)

1) SOC2_REPORT_Q3_2027.pdf — current Type II attestation; scope: infrastructure and inference platform (control IDs mapped in the file). Attestation date: 2027-09-30; auditor: NorthGate Assurance.

2) SIG_CAIQ_MAPPING_2028.xlsx — completed CAIQ answers crosswalked to Brightline’s likely control baseline; rows tagged where we have compensating or additional controls (see column H notes).

3) DPA_redline_v3.docx — includes our standard security and liability terms plus a proposed retention clause: default retention windows = logs/observability 30 days; embeddings/derived vectors 90 days; backups encrypted and retained for 60 days. We included an opt-in longer-retention appendix for customers requiring >90 days (commercial review required).

Key technical notes to highlight for Brightline:
- Data residency: Hosted US regions only for Brightline by default (can discuss EU options if needed).
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ for transit; AES-256 for data at rest; KMS-backed key management; customer-managed keys (CMK) available on Dedicated/Private.
- Audit evidence: syslogs and access logs retained per the retention windows above; we can produce a SOC2 subreport showing control evidence on request (non-public).

I will upload the two artifacts to the shared drive and send the HubSpot link. We expect no blockers to deliver these artifacts by EOD today. If Brightline wants a longer retention commitment in the DPA (e.g., 2 years), we will need procurement/commercial sign-off — that’s a 1-2 week add-on depending on risk review.

—Karthik
